title: Tutte’s 5-Flow conjecture
statement: Tutte’s 5-Flow conjecture · 1954. Every bridgeless graph admits a nowhere-zero 5-flow.

counterexample.description: A connected bridgeless cubic graph on 38 vertices with no nowhere-zero flow over Z/5Z. This restricted witness still refutes the general conjecture, and the complete check performs the complete modular-flow search.
